qualification_transfer: Source review establishes planned local selected source/build/embed equivalence to accepted458, plus112 evidence-only files. Acceptance still attests only exact458 compile and exactcc37 runtime. This is no new whole-feature compile/runtime run, global/main/native/race/live qualification or automatic canonical credit.
static_selection_limits: Static source import traversal, not Go package discovery, type checking or MVS computation.
Explicit root go.mod require/replace mappings and existing local module cache only; missing entries are not downloaded.
Linux/amd64 filename and go:build constraints are interpreted; cgo/goexperiment selections remain explicit ambiguities.
Dependency tests excluded; only root-package test files included. Standard library/runtime not recursively audited.
Call candidates include conversions and deferred function-literal bodies; they require manual classification.
Individual local file SHA256 values are recorded; module zip/go.sum authenticity is not independently checked.
